title: KubeCon 2026 - vendor contacts & expense reminders (scratchpad)
content:
Quick scratchpad for KubeCon 2026 travel admin - vendor contacts, bill capture reminders, and reimbursements. Informal notes to self and team.

High-level status:
- Flights booked for team (see travel sheet) - need to upload receipts to Expensify by 2026-02-22.
- Hotel: conference rate held; master bill to be split - follow up with venue billing contact for invoice by 2026-03-01.
- Vendor invoices (swag, catering, AV) arriving early March - track due dates and PO numbers.

Immediate TODOs:
- (by 2026-02-20) Confirm PO numbers with Finance for catering and AV. Contact: Finance Ops (jira #JIRA-1024).
- (by 2026-02-22) Remind attendees to upload receipts + brief note about acceptable items (meals over per-diem require explanation).
- (by 2026-02-25) Collect final attendee list for badge reconciliation and vendor billing.

Expense reminders / rules to include in attendee email:
- Upload receipts to Expensify within 7 days of expense.
- Personal charges on company card are not allowed. If used accidentally, add note and submit reimbursement request with manager approval.
- Per-diem: $75/day domestic (check Confluence page for exceptions). Meals included in registration/catering should not be claimed.
- Taxis/rideshares: add brief reason (airport transfer, vendor run). Keep itemized receipts.

Vendor contacts (working list) - save these on events drive and ping them in-thread:
- AV (Apex AV Solutions) - main: Jordan Reed, jordan@apexav.com, +1-415-555-0198 - estimate attached (invoice expected net 30).
- Catering (BluePlate Events) - main: Marta Ruiz, marta@blueplate.co, +1-415-555-0102 - PO required, dietary notes attached.
- Swag vendor (PrintHouse SW) - main: Ken Park, ken@printhouse.com, +1-415-555-0111 - shipping to venue; ask for final packing list and tracking.
- Hotel billing contact (Marriot Conference Sales) - sales: Linda Gomez, linda.gomez@marriot.com, +1-415-555-0123 - request master folio and breakdown for accounting.

Notes for invoices/POs:
- Always include Redwood Inference billing address, PO number, and the event code (RWI-KC-026).
- For split charges (multiple internal teams), request line-item detail to allocate across cost centers.
- Keep PDFs of invoices in shared folder: shared_drives/product/events/kubecon-2026/billing.

Reimbursements flow (summary for FA processing):
- Employee submits on Expensify -> Manager approves -> Finance reviews within 5 business days -> Payment (ACH) within next payroll cycle.
- For high-dollar vendor prepayments, ensure Finance signs off on payment schedule and that insurance/cancellations terms are documented.

Checklist for attendee email (to send 2026-02-20):
- Upload receipts to Expensify
- Note per-diem rules + meal exclusions
- How to tag expenses (project code + cost center)
- Emergency contact at event (on-call events ops: +1-415-555-0133)
- Reminder about swipe card for hotel incidentals (if used)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Need confirmation from Finance: can we approve vendor partial payment (50%) before event? Who signs vendor contract? (tagging @Samantha).
- Do we need additional insurance rider for swag shipping? Follow up with legal.
- Confirm whether AV vendor can provide warranty on on-site tech support hours beyond 8pm.

Draft email snippet to attendees (short):
"Hi all - quick reminders for KubeCon travel expenses: please upload all receipts to Expensify within 7 days; label expenses with project code RWI-KC-026; note that meals covered by the conference or catering should not be claimed. If you used the company card for incidentals, add a short note in the report. Reach out to events-ops@redwood.com with questions."

Misc notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider rolling last-minute per-diem exceptions into a single reconciliation form to reduce approvals.
- Track vendor SLA clauses (cancellation windows) and store in contracts folder.

References: Confluence KubeCon-2026-travel-policy, Slack #events-kubecon-2026 (thread: vendor quotes), JIRA-1024 (Finance PO).

-- Olivia

(End of scratchpad: informal, update and move finalized items into shared_drives/product/events/kubecon-2026 when ready.)
